articles.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
articles.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has introduced new policies establishing data standards for event contracts and prediction markets. These guidelines are intended to ensure that platforms, including those leveraging cryptocurrency, satisfy federal financial compliance and transparency requirements. This move represents an effort by the agency to formalize oversight as these types of trading products become more widespread.

articles.title: How COP31 became climate diplomacy’s ‘darkest moment’
articles.summary: The selection process for the 2026 UN climate summit, known as COP31, has reached a diplomatic impasse as nations struggle to agree on a host city. Persistent competition between Australia and Turkey has created a deadlock that observers describe as a significant setback for international cooperation. This lack of consensus threatens to disrupt the planning and momentum of future global environmental negotiations.

articles.title: 25 Years Later, GTA 3 Is Still the Most Fascinating Open-World Experiment

articles.title: I’ve been married for 58 years. It’s ‘our’ money, not ‘his’ and ‘hers.’ Why do so many couples keep their finances separate?
articles.summary: An increasing number of modern couples are choosing to maintain separate finances rather than pooling their income into shared accounts. This shift contrasts with traditional models where spouses treated all assets as collective property, even in single-income households. The trend highlights a significant change in how different generations approach financial independence within a marriage.

articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
articles.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Ship, a new suite of developer tools designed to automate aspects of the software review workflow. The system enables autonomous AI agents to evaluate, correct, and sign off on routine code submissions. This feature is intended to ease developer bottlenecks caused by the growing volume of AI-assisted programming.

articles.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios

articles.title: A 194-year-old tortoise has a remarkable anti-aging secret hidden in its DNA
articles.summary: Researchers have identified nearly 300 unique genetic markers in Jonathan, a 194-year-old giant tortoise currently recognized as the world's oldest living land animal. These biological findings suggest that his longevity is driven by specific genes that facilitate DNA repair, manage inflammation, and naturally suppress the development of cancer.
